subject: Quick note on Polydon Industries's website
bodyText:
Hi,

I'm Mani from Rogue.

We look for solid businesses that still look stuck online - and Polydon Industries stood out.

Doncaster metal forming and fabrication at Polydon Park - and polydon.co.uk still ships as a Dreamweaver template site in iso-8859-1, still publishes Fax: 01302 341483, and still carries a Copyright 2000 mark. Thirty-plus years of CNC, welding and fabrication; a front end frozen like an early-2000s brochure page.

If useful, I'll send a short 3-point teardown over email - what's dated, what's costing you, and the first fix. No call required.

Reply YES and I'll send it.
